s = open('refmodel.py').read()
helper = '''
_FAIL_LINE = [0]
def fail():
    import traceback
    _FAIL_LINE[0] = traceback.extract_stack()[-2].lineno
    return (False, None)
'''
s = s.replace("def py_validate(image):", helper + "\ndef py_validate(image):", 1)
# only inside py_validate: replace 'return (False, None)' after the marker

head, tail = s[:idx], s[idx:]
tail = tail.replace("return (False, None)", "return fail()")
s = head + tail
s += "\n"
open('refmodel.py','w').write(s)
